Børne-Unge Psyk. Afd. 40 is a child and adolescent psychiatric department operating within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] in Denmark. It is documented in the Danish ADHD Database's annual report for 2023/24, which evaluates diagnostic practices and quality indicators in child psychiatry [^src1].

The department is specifically measured against quality indicator 2a, which tracks the proportion of ADHD assessment processes for children aged 0–5 who receive a clinical environmental observation within 120 days of the assessment starting [^src1]. The national standard for this indicator is set at ≥ 90% [^src1]. Børne-Unge Psyk. Afd. 40 achieved a compliance rate of 23%, completing the observation within the timeframe for 9 out of 40 cases [^src1]. 

Significantly, the data reported for Børne-Unge Psyk. Afd. 40 is identical to the aggregated regional data for the entirety of [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src1]. This indicates that the department serves as the central or sole data provider for the region concerning this specific indicator [^src1]. The department's performance reflects a broader national trend highlighted in the report, where only the regions of Southern Denmark and Central Jutland, along with a few individual departments, managed to meet the 90% standard, prompting discussions regarding resource distribution, clinical capacity, and variations in practice across different age groups and geographical areas [^src1].
